commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== SERIAL PORTS ==='
(ls -1 /dev/cu.* /dev/tty.* 2>/dev/null || true) | sort -u
echo '=== PYSerial ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
try:
    from serial.tools import list_ports
    ports=list(list_ports.comports())
    if not ports:
        print('NO_PYSERIAL_PORTS')
    for p in ports:
        print(f'DEVICE={p.device} DESC={p.description} HWID={p.hwid} VID={p.vid} PID={p.pid} SERIAL={p.serial_number} LOCATION={p.location} MANUFACTURER={p.manufacturer} PRODUCT={p.product}')
except Exception as e:
    print('PYSERIAL_ERROR', repr(e))
PY
echo '=== USB PROFILE MATCHES ==='
(system_profiler SPUSBDataType 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -Ei -B4 -A12 'Espressif|ESP32|USB JTAG|CP210|CH34|CH910|FTDI' || true
